integrity: The variance identity is taken from the cited motivating source; the feasible derivative range and extremal-law classification are proved independently by a discrete concave-envelope argument. Numerical checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive-integer base completion times under memoryless per-step catastrophe with fixed catastrophe probability. For p<s the upper variance endpoint is a supremum, not an attained maximum. No full-distribution or higher-moment extremality is claimed.
title: Sharp variance envelope at fixed success probability under memoryless catastrophe
